I took a week long course on R. We spent our time learning and coding with ggplot.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

mpg

ggplot(
  data = mpg,
  mapping = aes(
    x = cty,
    y = hwy,
    color = year,
  ) 
) + geom_point(position = "jitter", alpha = 0.6) 
```

```{r}

ggplot(
  data = mpg,
  mapping = aes(
    x = cty,
    y = hwy,
    color = year,
    shape = drv
  ) 
) + geom_point(position = "jitter", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "MPG while in the city vs highway")
```
